one_month_reasoning: In-window: Q3 2026 results, most likely Thu Oct 22 (FCX has not announced; prior Q3s Oct 19-23, 2026 reports on Thursdays), vs consensus $0.74 on 750M lb at a $6.00 H2 deck. Q3 LME copper averaged well above $6, so a price-driven beat is likely, but the stock's reaction will turn on the Grasberg ramp (65% H2-26, PB2/3 capped until the chute fix) and early 2027 colour (guided >20% volume growth, $4.8B capex). Tariff: the 90-day window lapsed Sep 28 with no decision and the front-month COMEX premium is already gone (SMM Sep 29), so a 'no tariff' headline would do less damage than I assumed in round 1; a surprise tariff is unlikely before the midterms. LME Week and possible early 2027 TC/RC signals in October are mild positives; a Cobre Panama restart decision is a mild negative. Net: very slight positive tilt (centre ~$70.9) with ~13.5% monthly vol, near symmetric.

base.story: Copper $5.50-6.25 as zero TC/RCs and mine disruptions offset the refined surplus; Grasberg reaches ~80% by mid-27 and investors price 2028 full-run EPS ~$4 at 16-17x.

bull.story: Mine supply keeps disappointing (Chile strikes, grades, DRC/Indonesia cuts ICSG already flagged), copper $7+/lb, Grasberg at full rate early; 2028 EBITDA ~$20B+ and EPS ~$5.5 at 17-18x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$48 (-32%) the market would be discounting copper below ~$5/lb (2028E EPS ~$3.3 at 15x = ~$50) or a failed Grasberg restoration / adverse Indonesian action on PTFI. With concentrate markets still at zero TC/RCs that most likely signals a fundamental break rather than copper-beta noise at ~45% vol.

reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor's fact-checks fixed three errors in my bridge: tax is ~31% not 38% (lifts EPS ~$0.4), net debt for EV is $5.3B, and consensus 2027 EPS is directly observable at $4.16. It also showed the front-month COMEX tariff premium has already collapsed (verified in SMM Sep 29), so spot $6.56 is an LME-level price. Following up in my industry lane I found something I had wrong: my round-1 claim that ICSG projects 2026-27 deficits was stale (an Oct-2025 forecast); ICSG's June 2026 forecast is a 96kt 2026 surplus widening to 377kt in 2027 as concentrate availability and scrap improve, although benchmark TC/RCs remain $0 and Antofagasta has moved some sales to spot-indexed terms, i.e. the tightness is in concentrate, not refined metal. With ~770k st of COMEX stock that could return to LME, I trim my deck from $5.75 to $5.60 (the supervisor's own $6.00 I consider too close to spot given the refined surplus). Rebuilt valuation: P/E $66 (16.5x, down from 18x which the supervisor flagged as rich), FCF yield $66, and a consistent EV/EBITDA at 9x with NCI at a market-value 38% share $61, blended $65 (was $67). With the stock at $70.58 and strong copper momentum I centre the 12-month distribution at ~$69.5 (between fair value and spot, down from ~$71.5), ~43% lognormal vol with a 15% fat-left component for commodity/tail risk. Research limited to ~6 follow-up queries; no option data used.
